# Diamond Fishing Spoon

![Render](render.png)

## Description
This is a parametric 3D model for a diamond-shaped fishing spoon with a twist. Inspired by the classic buzz bomb shape, it features a place for an eye and includes an option to add a scale-like texture using a diamond shape pattern, enhancing its appeal in the water.

## Try it out
To modify the model or print an STL/3MF file, you can view this live in the OpenSCAD playground by following this link:
[OpenSCAD Playground](https://ochafik.com/openscad2/#)
